# swarmflow

> Deterministic control plane for orchestrating swarms of local coding agents:
> PRD in, verified MVP out.

Docs:
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: roles, task state machine, failure taxonomy, capacity numbers
- docs/WORKFLOW.md: PRD -> MVP stages, evidence bundle, human PR gate
- docs/PLAN_SCHEMA.md: plan.yaml format (tasks, ownership, test_command, acceptance)
- docs/CASE_STUDY.md: first validation run outcomes and incidents
- AGENTS.md: repository guide for coding agents
- AGENTS.worker.md: worker rules template injected into scaffolded projects

Quickstart:
  pip install -e ".[dev]"
  swarmflow init
  swarmflow smoke-frontier && swarmflow smoke-worker
  swarmflow plan-load --plan examples/smoke-plan.yaml --project <path>
  swarmflow freeze --project <path>
  swarmflow wave-run --wave 1
  swarmflow audit --project <path> --json

Brownfield (existing repos):
  swarmflow recon --project <repo>        # deterministic survey + digest
  plan.yaml with mode: brownfield         # planner prompt gets the recon digest
  swarmflow plan-load --plan plan.yaml    # git preflight, run branch, .swarmflow/
  swarmflow wave-run --wave 1             # per-wave freeze, regression gate, audit
  swarmflow evidence --project <repo>     # bundle for verifier/acceptance

Tests: python -m pytest tests -q (no network required).
